{{Quote|There are two hundred residents in the T'iil Blossom Homes. Families who were off planet on vacation, businessmen, students on school trips - every survivor has a different story, though of course they all end in the same tragic way. It's been our honor as Delayans to offer a safe and happy refuge.|[[Var Lyonn]] to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="hostage">''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]''</ref>}}
The '''T'iil Blossom Homes''' was a building constructed in the city of [[Leilani]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]]. The building housed rich [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] refugees after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="hostage" />
